variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Optional choices with their own SKU, barcode, price and bulk stock.
variants.legacyDescription: Earlier lightweight variants retained for compatibility. New variants are full inventory items in the family above.
variants.serializedDisabled: Variants are disabled for serialized tracking. Identified units continue to use the item-level stock workflow.
variants.empty: No variants. The parent item continues to work exactly as before.
variants.stockHelp: Positive values receive stock; negative values issue stock. Parent and variant totals update atomically.

errors.invalidForm: Enter a name and a non-negative whole opening quantity.
errors.invalidStock: Enter a non-zero whole stock change.

family.title: Variant family
family.description: Linked variants are full inventory items with their own operations.
family.variantDescription: Variant of {{name}}, with its own stock and history.
family.noSiblings: There are no other variants in this family yet.

create.title: Create variant
create.inheritanceHelp: Shared details and the bill of materials inherit from the primary item. Stock, locations, serialization, relationships, and manufacturing history remain independent.

connect.title: Connect existing item
connect.help: The selected item becomes a variant of {{name}}. It keeps its stock, locations, serial units, relationships, assignments, and history. Existing differences in shared details and its bill of materials are kept as overrides.
connect.success: Connected {{name}} as a variant. Its operational data remains attached to that item.

detach.confirm: Detach this variant from {{name}}? Its current shared details and effective bill of materials will be kept. Stock, locations, serial units, relationships, assignments, and build history will stay with this item.
detach.success: Detached from {{name}}. This item and all of its operational history remain intact.

empty.title: No linked variants
empty.description: Create a variant or connect an existing inventory item while managing its operations independently.

errors.load: Unable to load the variant family.
errors.connect: Unable to connect the existing item.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the variant.

options.title: Option groups
options.description: Define choices once, then generate connected inventory variants.
options.variantHelp: This item remains a full inventory record. Its stock, locations, serial units, relationships, and build history are independent.
options.combinations_one: {{value}} combination; the default remains the primary item.
options.combinations_other: {{value}} combinations; the default remains the primary item.
options.defaultHint: The primary item will represent all default values.

empty.title: No option groups
empty.description: Add dimensions such as Language or Frame. Optionally connect a group to one BOM slot so each value swaps exactly that component.

editor.help: Keep this simple: most groups only need a name and values. Select a BOM slot only when this choice should replace a physical component.

generate.confirm_one: Generate {{value}} full inventory variant now? Definitions will be locked afterwards.
generate.confirm_other: Generate {{value}} full inventory variants now? Definitions will be locked afterwards.

errors.invalidGroup: Complete the name and key for option group {{group}}. The key must begin with a letter.
errors.invalidValue: Enter a label and code for value {{value}} in {{group}}.
errors.missingComponent: Select a component for value {{value}} in {{group}}.
errors.duplicateValues: Use unique labels and codes in {{group}}.

errors.notFound: This inventory item could not be found.
errors.delete: Unable to delete this inventory item.

details.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? This also deletes its option groups, option selections, media, other item-owned records, and any unused option values that use it as a component. This cannot be undone.

share.emptyDescription: Create a link above when you want to share this item.
